qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md ('Gates must exclude convincing dead apps')
evidence: Gates: scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; both gate judge.toml use aggregation='all_pass' with one binary criterion; score.py:41-48 zeroes reward unless every gate > 0 and test.sh:213-227 runs gates then score.py before the scored suite. render/judge.toml:26-33 (authenticated_render) requires a real Kittle & Rowe chat (not blank/static mock/generic error), nothing private before sign-in, wrong password rejected and gwen@kittle.test/password123 opening her matters - the auth leg. constraints/judge.toml:26-36 (server_backed_local_application) requires Gwen to post 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' in M-11, reload, then harriet@kittle.test in a SEPARATE browser context sees it - an actual write plus independent-context readback, which defeats static shells, client-only/localStorage facades and per-tab state (REVIEW_POLICY 'convincing dead apps'). Seed confirms M-11 client=gwen, walled=[] so Harriet can read it. Scored: functional/prompt.md:11-19, polish/prompt.md:10-18, visual/prompt.md:18-26 each restate the 'Global browser gate' (loads from localhost:3000 without fatal error, gwen signs in and sees protected content, blank page/empty workspace/static mock/static shell/missing backend fails, content must be backed by the running local server) and end 'If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension'; polish/visual say it is the only all-or-nothing rule - no partial credit on gate failure. Functional is mode='individual', so each per-criterion session re-applies the gate to its own criterion, which still zeroes the dimension; no functional criterion walls Gwen from M-11/M-13 or changes her credentials, so the gate stays satisfiable throughout the sequential run. Same-origin: grep for 'same.origin|cross.origin' across task/tests returns nothing; every gate explicitly allows external font/script/CDN requests (render prompt:12-13, constraints prompt:13-14 and criterion:29-30, each scored gate). 'Local server' / 'backed by the running local server' matches the public brief (integration.md:3 'matter data stays in our own server and database', port 3000), i.e. server-backed not same-origin, consistent with #35's note. The internal sheet's 'cross-origin apps' annotation is superseded by the public row wording and SKILL delivery profile (network public); the task correctly follows the public wording. Adversarial: a static shell or client-only fake sign-in passes neither the constraints gate (cross-context readback fails) nor the scored gates; a conforming app with CDN assets or a different but server-backed asset layout is not failed. Minor note (P3, not a defect): the scored-gate phrase 'seeded-looking facade' could in principle tempt a judge to distrust correctly served seed data, but the next sentence ('real task data backed by the running local server') disambiguates. Risk=true only because runtime evidence on THESE bytes is missing: raw-evidence-index hosted runs (Oracle render/constraints 1.0, nop 0) are of the previous v2 bytes, and the nop 0 came from the liveness no_op path, not the judge gate; the scripted golden 'gate_constraints PASS' (golden-run.log:1) is not a configured judge run, and no facade/negative app has been run through the gate judges.
